smooth.description: Our SMOOTH technology allows cushioned and silent closures, which provides great comfort to furniture.

touch.description: The innovative TOUCH technology allows completely mechanical openings, effortlessly and furniture fronts without handles or pulls.

standard.description: The STANDARD technology guarantees great durability and excellent performance for the products we develop, that's why it is applied to many of our designs.

catalog.title: CATALOG
catalog.description: Discover our hardware created to offer functionality, style and durability in every project. With cutting-edge technology and innovative designs, each product is designed to exceed the most demanding expectations.

about.headerTitle:
We create hardware designed to improve
every project.
about.paragraph1: The brand began from a personal impulse in 2016, as we are the third generation in the commercialization of products for the furniture industry. From which there is experience and also motivation to continue learning and innovating.
about.paragraph2: In the beginning we manufactured basic items. Subsequently, in 2017, we carried out market and product studies in order to be inspired by novelties worldwide, bringing originality to each project. At the same time, we ventured into technical creation, where quality and durability also represent our direction.
about.paragraph3: The goal is and continues to be to facilitate access to modern products that will contribute to realizing each idea easily, effectively and persistently.

mission.title: MISSION
mission.description: To listen and understand traditional and new customers who trust the brand to deploy products with the best technology and quality standards.

vision.title: VISION
vision.paragraph1: To create and develop products for the manufacturing and application of each furniture piece, optimizing every space, and withstanding demands of daily use in the long term.
vision.paragraph2: To strengthen the brand in future markets, transcend generations, and leave a mark on each experience of its use.
